Fixed in `f32e9a6`. The `@objectstack/spec` package already exports a `PluginContext` type (re-exported at line 910 of `index.ts`), so adding another `PluginContext` from `./plugin-scope` caused a TS2300 duplicate identifier error. Renamed the ObjectUI-specific interface to `AppPluginContext` across all usages (types, core, and example plugins).
